_meta.description: Validated crafting dependency graph, generated by scripts/crafting_graph.py from the raw game DataTables. Item ingredient counts are the raw per-recipe amounts and each craftable item carries productCount (units yielded per craft) - one craft consumes 'ingredients' and produces 'productCount'. Building materials are per structure. Referential and cycle validation passed at generation time. Consumed by scripts/build_items_json.py and scripts/build_buildings_json.py.
